# befui

> Copy-paste React components (Radix + Tailwind 4 + CSS variables) with real motion, plus HRMS and marketing blocks. You own the files: add them with the CLI, then import from `@/components/ui/<name>`.

## Setup
- One time: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui init` (theme CSS, cn helper, AGENTS.md rules, .mcp.json)
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add <name> [name...]` or `add all`; blocks are `block:<name>`. It also installs npm packages and any befui files a component imports. (There is no `befui` package on npm: `npx befui` will fail, always use the `github:` form.)
- CLI blocked or GitHub unreachable? Do not retype components and never swap in another icon package. Fetch the JSON for the component (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/<name>.json, or the same `/r/<name>.json` path on the docs site), write every `files[].content` to `src/<path>`, do the same for every name in its `requires` (`icons` is the common one: r/icons.json, it holds every icon), `npm i` its `deps`, and merge `r/init.json` (cn helper, theme CSS) once.
- Exact source of any component as JSON (files, npm deps, requires, example): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/<name>.json (blocks: block-<name>.json). Every name below works in that URL.
- MCP: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui mcp` gives tools list_components, get_component (format "html" for plain HTML/htmx), get_html_rules, add_components
- Icons: our own set in `@/components/ui/icons`, e.g. `import { SearchIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons'`; no icon package needed
- Theme: CSS variables in index.css (--primary, --ring, --accent...). Dark mode = `dark` class on <html>. Use tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`), never hard-coded colors.
- Full catalog with a working example per component: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-full.txt
- Building a mobile app in Flutter (Android and iOS)? The same components exist as Flutter widgets, copy-paste with `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add <name> --flutter`. Rules and an example for every widget: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-flutter.txt
- Not using React (plain HTML, htmx, Django, Rails, PHP)? Every component is also a custom element, `<bef-button>`, `<bef-dialog>`... Rules and an HTML example for every component: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-html.txt

## Rules that save a debugging round
- Wrap the app once in `<TooltipProvider>` (tooltip) and render `<Toaster />` once, then call `toast.success('Saved')` anywhere (toast).
- Sidebar, AppShell: put `SidebarProvider` above them. Dialog and Sheet are the same primitive; use `SheetContent` for a side drawer.
- Stateful inputs are controlled: pass `value` and `onChange` (or `checked` / `onCheckedChange` for checkbox and switch).
- Tables: `table` is bare parts for static layouts. `data-table` adds sort, filter, pagination, row selection (`selectable`, `bulkActions`), a column menu (`columnMenu`) and a sticky header (`maxHeight`); you pass rows and `Column[]`.
- Animated components need keyframes from index.css: run `npx github:RandomKid24/befui update` after adding (`--check` to only report).
- Fixed colors on purpose: terminal (always dark), avatar and tag-manager (per-name tints). Everything else follows theme tokens.
- Merge classes with `cn` from `@/lib/utils`. Edit copied files freely; `add <name> --force` overwrites local edits.

## Which component for what
- Dates, delivery and changes: week-strip (pick a day), day-agenda (one day as a time grid), order-tracker (delivery steps), diff-viewer (before and after text), event-calendar (month and week), countdown
- Status, ranking and reviews: uptime-bar (status page), leaderboard (ranked people), rating-breakdown (review summary), credit-card (card preview that flips, for checkout and add-card forms)
- Draw a chart: trend over time: line-chart or area-chart (stacked); compare categories: charts BarChart or stacked-bar-chart; share of whole: DonutChart or radial-bar-chart; correlation or outliers: scatter-chart; day-by-hour or cohort grid: matrix-heatmap; yearly activity: heatmap; tiny trend in a card: Sparkline; live feed: live-chart; stages: funnel-chart; scores on axes: radar-chart; parts of a budget: treemap; start-to-end bridge (profit): waterfall-chart; flow between stages: sankey-chart; mix shifting over time: stream-chart; price range per period: candlestick-chart; rank changes: bump-chart; seasonal cycle: rose-chart; KPI vs target: bullet-chart; before vs after per item: dumbbell-chart; percent of 100 as squares: waffle-chart; nested breakdown: sunburst-chart; per-row curves: ridgeline-chart; spread and outliers: box-plot-chart; flow between every pair: chord-chart; parts of a whole: pie-chart (3 to 5 slices) or half-donut-chart (short card); cyclic data like 24 hours: radial-line-chart; distribution of raw values: histogram-chart; few causes behind most of a problem: pareto-chart; two moments per item: slope-chart or dumbbell-chart; two groups back to back: butterfly-chart; many ranked items: lollipop-chart; bubbles by size: circle-pack-chart; share by size and group: marimekko-chart; dots sized by value in a grid: punch-card-chart; projection with a likely range: forecast-chart; overlap of two or three groups: venn-chart; frequent words: word-cloud. Five to eight scores as a pentagon or hexagon: radar-chart. The explanation of each chart (what it shows, how to read it, when to use or skip it) is in llms-full.txt; give it to the user when they ask what a chart means. All animate in on scroll.
- Show tabular data: table (static), data-table (sort/filter/select/paginate), permission-matrix (roles by permissions), kanban (cards in columns), heatmap, charts, line-chart, radar-chart, funnel-chart, gantt (schedule), org-chart, saved-views (table presets), audit-log (who changed what), file-manager
- Hint or explain on hover: tooltip (title, shortcut, arrow), InfoTip and TruncatedText (both exported by tooltip), popover for richer content, hover-card (rich preview that opens on hover or focus, e.g. a profile)
- Pick a value: select, combobox, radio-group, segmented, chip, switch, checkbox, slider, calendar, date-picker, time-picker, color-picker, toggle-group (several buttons can stay pressed, formatting toolbars), button-group (joined buttons)
- Type text or numbers: input, search-input, search-bar, password-input, otp-input, currency-input, number-stepper, tag-input, inline-edit, datetime-picker, image-upload, rich-text-editor (HTML), schema-form (form from a JSON-like description, wizard with steps), notification-preferences, mention-input (@ people), coupon-input, input-group (a field with prefix or suffix addons like https:// or .com)
- Confirm, ask, or show a form on top: dialog, alert-dialog (destructive), dialog's Sheet (side drawer), popover, context-menu (right click), image-viewer (lightbox), bottom-sheet (mobile)
- Loading and failure states: loader (ring/dots/bars/pulse/orbit/dual, BarLoader, LoadingOverlay), skeleton, spinner, empty-state, error-state (404/500), pull-to-refresh
- Workflows and settings: approval-flow (approver chain), onboarding-checklist, tag-manager, notification-preferences, shortcuts-dialog (press ?), permission-matrix
- Guide a new user: tour (spotlight walkthrough of the real page), onboarding-checklist, onboarding-carousel (mobile intro)
- Format numbers: format (formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration, Currency); defaults to INR and en-IN
- Online shop and checkout: product-card (and Price), order-summary, coupon-input, number-stepper (quantity), rating
- Reorder or resize: sortable-list (rows), kanban (cards across columns), split-pane (resizable panels)
- Tell the user something: toast (transient), alert (inline), banner (page-wide), notification-center (inbox), cookie-consent
- Navigate: sidebar, app-shell, navbar (top bar), user-menu (avatar menu), theme-toggle (dark mode), settings-layout (side nav for settings), bottom-nav (mobile), swipe-actions (row gestures), tabs, breadcrumb, pagination, stepper, command (Ctrl K), table-of-contents, fab, navigation-menu (desktop mega menu in a top bar), menubar (File, Edit, View bar)
- Show KPIs and status: stat-card, bar-list (ranked bars), description-list (details), invoice, gauge, progress, progress-ring, number-ticker, badge, status-dot, charts (Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart)
- Show people and activity: avatar, profile-card, activity-feed, timeline, chat, comment-thread, changelog, testimonial-card, rating, terminal (CLI output)
- Time: time-picker, analog-clock, world-clock, stopwatch, timer, countdown, relative-time
- Whole pages: see Page recipes below; all blocks are listed under Blocks

## Page recipes (start from a block, then edit it)
Add the block with `add block:<name>`; it pulls in everything it uses. Layout frames: wrap pages in `app-shell` (sidebar), or use `block:top-nav-layout` (navbar, no sidebar).
- Admin app frame (sidebar + topbar): block:admin-shell. Topbar extras: theme-toggle, user-menu, notification-center, command (Ctrl K)
- Analytics / traffic dashboard: block:analytics-dashboard (stat-card, line-chart, donut, bar-list)
- Sales or CRM dashboard: block:sales-dashboard, block:lead-pipeline, block:campaign-performance
- Online store admin: block:ecommerce-dashboard, block:checkout-page, block:invoice-page
- Project or team dashboard: block:project-overview, kanban, gantt, org-chart
- HR / people: block:hrms-overview, block:employee-directory, block:leave-approvals, block:leave-request-form
- Users, roles, API keys: block:user-management (invite dialog + table), permission-matrix, block:api-keys-page
- Account area: block:settings-page (tabs) or settings-layout (side nav), block:profile-page, block:billing-page
- Sign in / sign up / reset: block:sign-in, block:sign-up, block:reset-password
- Marketing site: block:landing-page (landing-sections: Hero, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner, SiteFooter + navbar), block:pricing-page, comparison-table
- Mail or messages: block:inbox, chat, comment-thread
- Error pages: block:not-found-page or error-state (code 403, 404, 500)
- Details panel for one record: description-list inside a card, plus timeline or audit-log for history

## Components (200)

### Layout (5)
- `app-shell`: Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header. Exports: AppShell, Topbar, AppContent, PageHeader. Needs: sidebar.
- `landing-sections`: Marketing page parts: Hero, LogoStrip, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner and SiteFooter. Stack them with a Navbar. Exports: Hero, FeatureGrid, LogoStrip, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner, SiteFooter. Needs: accordion.
- `settings-layout`: Settings page frame: vertical section list on the left, SettingsSection rows (title and help on the left, controls on the right). Exports: SettingsLayout, SettingsSection.
- `sidebar`: Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile. Exports: useSidebar, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, .... Needs: dialog, icons, tooltip.
- `split-pane`: Two resizable panels with a draggable divider. Keyboard resizable. Horizontal or vertical. Exports: SplitPane.

### Navigation (15)
- `bottom-nav`: Mobile tab bar with icons, labels, an active pill and count badges. Exports: BottomNav.
- `breadcrumb`: Trail of parent pages. Exports: Breadcrumb. Needs: icons.
- `dock`: Icons that grow toward the pointer, like the macOS dock. Exports: Dock.
- `menubar`: Desktop-app style bar of menus (File, Edit, View) with shortcuts and checkable items. Exports: MenubarMenu, Menubar, MenubarTrigger, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarSeparator, MenubarShortcut. Needs: icons.
- `navbar`: Top bar with brand, links and actions that folds into a menu on small screens. Exports: Navbar. Needs: icons.
- `navigation-menu`: Desktop top-bar menu whose items open mega-menu panels, with keyboard and focus handled. Exports: NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, navigationMenuTriggerStyle. Needs: icons.
- `onboarding-carousel`: Mobile first-run intro with swipeable slides, dots, Skip and a final Get started button. Exports: OnboardingCarousel. Needs: button.
- `order-tracker`: Delivery progress as steps joined by a line that fills up to the current one. Horizontal on wide screens, vertical on phones. Exports: OrderTracker. Needs: icons.
- `pagination`: Page buttons with ellipsis for long ranges. Exports: Pagination. Needs: icons.
- `scroll-progress`: Thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or a container. Exports: ScrollProgress.
- `stepper`: Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding. Exports: Stepper. Needs: icons.
- `table-of-contents`: On this page list that highlights the section currently in view. Exports: TableOfContents.
- `tabs`: Underline or pill tabs on Radix Tabs. Exports: Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.
- `tree-view`: Nested expandable list with animated open and close. Exports: TreeView. Needs: icons.
- `user-menu`: Avatar button for the topbar that opens a menu with name, email, your links and Sign out. Exports: UserMenu. Needs: avatar, dropdown-menu, icons.

### Inputs (42)
- `avatar-upload`: Click-to-change profile picture with instant preview, size and type checks, and a Remove link. Exports: AvatarUpload. Needs: avatar, icons.
- `button`: Thirteen variants from plain to glow, shine and 3D press, pill shape, five sizes, loading state, and asChild for links. Exports: Button. Needs: icons.
- `button-group`: Buttons joined into one row or column with shared borders and rounded outer corners. Exports: ButtonGroup.
- `calendar`: Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work. Exports: startOfDay, addDays, addMonths, isSameDay, Calendar. Needs: icons.
- `checkbox`: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows. Exports: Checkbox. Needs: icons.
- `chip`: Toggleable filter chips, single or multi select. Exports: Chip, ChipGroup. Needs: icons.
- `color-picker`: Swatches, hex field and the native picker. Always returns a six-digit hex. Exports: ColorPicker. Needs: icons.
- `combobox`: Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option. Exports: Combobox, MultiCombobox. Needs: badge, command, icons, popover.
- `copy-button`: Copies text and morphs to a check. Exports: CopyButton. Needs: icons.
- `coupon-input`: Promo code field with async validation, an error message and a removable applied chip. Exports: CouponInput. Needs: button, icons, input.
- `currency-input`: Money field that groups digits as you type (1,25,000) and hands you a plain number. Exports: CurrencyInput.
- `date-picker`: Date and date range fields that open a calendar. The range picker has optional quick presets (Last 7 days, This month...) and a day count. Closes on pick. Exports: formatDate, DatePicker, defaultRangePresets, DateRangePicker. Needs: calendar, icons, popover.
- `datetime-picker`: One field for a day and a time: calendar on top, time picker below. Exports: DateTimePicker. Needs: calendar, icons, popover, time-picker.
- `dropzone`: Drag and drop file area with size check and removable file list. Exports: Dropzone. Needs: icons.
- `fab`: Round primary action, extended with a label, or a speed dial that fans out actions. Exports: Fab. Needs: icons.
- `file-uploader`: Multi-file drop area with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and a concurrency limit. You supply the upload function. Exports: FileUploader. Needs: icons, progress.
- `image-upload`: Thumbnail grid with remove buttons, a cover label and a drop tile. Limits count, type and size. Exports: ImageUpload. Needs: icons.
- `inline-edit`: Text that becomes a field on click. Enter saves, Escape cancels. Exports: InlineEdit. Needs: icons.
- `input`: Text input and textarea with icon, trailing slot, and invalid state. Exports: Input, Textarea.
- `input-group`: One field with text, icons or buttons attached at the start or end, like https:// or .com. Exports: InputGroup, InputGroupInput, InputAddon.
- `label`: Label with required marker, plus Field for label, control and hint or error. Exports: Label, Field.
- `mention-input`: Textarea that suggests people when you type @. Arrow keys and Enter pick. Exports: MentionInput. Needs: avatar.
- `notification-preferences`: Grid of events by channel (email, push, SMS, in-app) with a switch per cell and a switch per channel. Exports: NotificationPreferences. Needs: switch.
- `number-stepper`: Number field with plus and minus buttons and arrow keys. Exports: NumberStepper. Needs: icons.
- `otp-input`: Code boxes with paste, backspace, arrow keys, autofill and a shake on error. Exports: OtpInput.
- `password-input`: Show and hide toggle with an optional strength meter. Exports: passwordScore, PasswordInput. Needs: icons, input.
- `phone-input`: Phone field with a country picker. Groups digits as you type and hands back the E.164 number and whether it is complete. Exports: COUNTRIES, PhoneInput.
- `radio-group`: Native radios as selectable cards with descriptions. Exports: RadioGroup.
- `rating`: Star rating with hover preview. Read-only when no handler is given. Exports: Rating. Needs: icons.
- `rich-text-editor`: Small editor with bold, italic, underline, heading, lists, quote and link. Value is HTML. Built on contentEditable, no dependency. Exports: RichTextEditor.
- `schema-form`: Build a form from a description: text, email, number, date, select, textarea and checkbox fields, validation, and optional multi-step wizard with a stepper. Exports: SchemaForm. Needs: button, checkbox, input, label, select, stepper.
- `search-bar`: Search field with live results, highlighted matches, recent searches and full keyboard control. Exports: SearchBar. Needs: icons.
- `search-input`: Search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and a slash shortcut to focus. Exports: SearchInput. Needs: icons.
- `segmented`: Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs. Exports: Segmented.
- `select`: Styled dropdown with groups, built on Radix Select. Exports: Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem. Needs: icons.
- `signature-pad`: Draw-your-signature canvas for mouse, touch and pen. Sharp on retina screens, exports a PNG. Exports: SignaturePad. Needs: button.
- `slider`: Native range input with a filled track and floating value bubble. Exports: Slider.
- `switch`: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Exports: Switch.
- `tag-input`: Type and press Enter to add chips. Backspace removes the last. Exports: TagInput. Needs: icons.
- `theme-toggle`: Icon button that flips light and dark mode and remembers the choice. Also exports a useTheme hook. Exports: useTheme, ThemeToggle. Needs: button, icons.
- `toggle`: Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers. Exports: Toggle.
- `toggle-group`: A row of toggles where one or several can be pressed, for formatting toolbars. Exports: ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem.

### Display (44)
- `accordion`: Collapsible sections with a smooth height animation. Single or multiple open. Exports: Accordion. Needs: icons.
- `activity-feed`: Who did what and when, grouped under Today and Yesterday, with live relative times and an optional quoted detail. Exports: ActivityFeed. Needs: avatar, relative-time.
- `approval-flow`: Chain of approvers with decisions, comments and times. The current approver gets Approve and Reject buttons. Exports: ApprovalFlow. Needs: avatar, button, icons.
- `avatar`: Image with initials fallback in a stable color. Five sizes, circle or square, presence dot (online, away, busy, offline), a stacked group with hover names, and UserInfo for avatar plus name and subtitle. Exports: Avatar, AvatarGroup, UserInfo.
- `badge`: Status pill with semantic colors and an optional dot. Exports: Badge.
- `border-beam`: A light beam that circles the border. For pricing cards and featured content. Exports: BorderBeam.
- `brand-icons`: Logos of popular services as single-colour SVGs that follow the text colour, for sign-in buttons and integration lists. Exports: GoogleIcon, GithubIcon, GitlabIcon, AppleIcon, XBrandIcon, FacebookIcon, InstagramIcon, YoutubeIcon, ....
- `card`: Bordered surface with header, content and footer parts. Exports: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.
- `carousel`: Scroll-snap slides with arrows and animated dots. Exports: Carousel. Needs: icons.
- `changelog`: Release notes: version and date on the left, tagged New, Improved, Fixed or Removed changes on the right. Exports: Changelog. Needs: badge.
- `chat`: Message bubbles with avatars, timestamps, a typing indicator and a composer. Enter sends. Exports: Chat. Needs: avatar, icons.
- `code-block`: Code with a title, optional line numbers and a copy button. No highlighter dependency. Exports: CodeBlock. Needs: icons.
- `collapsible`: One section that opens with a smooth height animation. Exports: Collapsible. Needs: icons.
- `comment-thread`: Nested comments with inline reply boxes, three levels deep. Exports: CommentThread. Needs: avatar, button, input.
- `compare`: Before and after slider. Drag or use arrow keys. Exports: Compare.
- `credit-card`: Payment card preview that flips in 3D to show the CVV. Formats as the user types, guesses Visa, Mastercard, AmEx or RuPay, and can mask the number. Exports: CreditCard.
- `description-list`: Label and value pairs for a details panel, in one to three columns, optionally with dividers. Exports: DescriptionList.
- `diff-viewer`: Before and after text as a unified diff: red removed lines, green added lines, line numbers, and unchanged stretches folded. Exports: DiffViewer.
- `empty-state`: Dashed placeholder with icon, text and an action. Exports: EmptyState.
- `format`: formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration and a signed Currency component. Indian rupees by default. Exports: formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration, Currency.
- `invoice`: Printable invoice with number, status, from and bill-to, line items, tax and total computed from the lines. Exports: Invoice. Needs: badge.
- `kbd`: Keyboard key hint. Exports: Kbd.
- `marquee`: Endless logo or tag scroll with edge fade. Pauses on hover. Exports: Marquee.
- `onboarding-checklist`: Getting-started card with a progress bar, tick-off items, short help text and actions. Collapsible. Exports: OnboardingChecklist. Needs: icons, progress.
- `order-summary`: Cart lines with subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total computed for you. Slots for a coupon field and a checkout button. Exports: OrderSummary.

### Data (61)
- `area-chart`: Smooth gradient areas, stacked or overlapping, that wipe in on scroll. Hover for a readout across series. Exports: smoothPath, AreaChart. Needs: charts.
- `audit-log`: Who changed what and when, with expandable before and after values. Exports: AuditLog. Needs: avatar, badge, icons.
- `bar-list`: Ranked list with a bar behind each row: top pages, products, sources, countries. Exports: BarList.

- `bump-chart`: Rank over time as smooth lines that swap places. Lines draw in one by one; hover a line or name to follow it. Exports: BumpChart. Needs: charts.
- `butterfly-chart`: Two bar sets back to back around shared rows, like a population pyramid. Bars grow outward from the middle. Exports: ButterflyChart. Needs: charts.
- `candlestick-chart`: Open, high, low and close per period. Green closed up, red closed down. Candles grow from their midpoint in sequence; hover for the four numbers. Exports: CandlestickChart. Needs: charts.
- `charts`: Sparkline, bar chart and donut in plain SVG. No chart library. Exports: useChartIn, Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart.
- `chord-chart`: Flow between every pair of items around a circle. Arcs sweep in, then ribbons fade in; hover an item to keep only its ribbons. Exports: ChordChart. Needs: charts.
- `circle-pack-chart`: One bubble per item, area by value, packed into a cluster. Bubbles pop out from the center biggest first; hover for the share. Exports: CirclePackChart. Needs: charts.
- `comparison-table`: Plans across the top, features down the side, a check, dash or text in each cell. For pricing pages. Exports: ComparisonTable. Needs: icons.
- `countdown`: Live countdown with flipping digits. Exports: Countdown.

You pass rows and column definitions. Exports: DataTable. Needs: button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, icons, pagination, table.
- `dumbbell-chart`: Change per item as two dots joined by a line: before and after, plan and actual. Green when good, red when bad. Exports: DumbbellChart. Needs: charts.
- `file-manager`: Folder browser with breadcrumb, list and grid views, selection and double-click or Enter to open. Exports: FileManager. Needs: icons.
- `filter-bar`: Removable filter chips with an Add filter menu: pick a field, then a value. Exports: FilterBar. Needs: button, icons, popover.
- `forecast-chart`: Solid line for what happened, dashed line inside a shaded band for what is expected. The band is the likely range. Exports: ForecastChart. Needs: area-chart, charts.

- `kanban`: Columns of draggable cards. Drag with the mouse or move a focused card with Alt and the arrow keys. Controlled, no drag library. Exports: Kanban.

- `live-chart`: Streaming line chart that slides left as new values arrive. You give it a function for the next value; pause it any time. Exports: LiveChart.
